items.criterion: A note written through the browser leaves no readable trace of its words in any text column.
items.judgment: Scan every text column for the run marker and its encodings after the save.

items.criterion: Items written together arrive exactly once across cursor pages.
items.judgment: Count each delivered uuid across every page of a full pull.

items.criterion: A stale write returns a version_conflict carrying the stored item.
items.judgment: Read the conflict entry and the stored envelope after the stale write.

items.criterion: A tombstone reaches a device holding an older cursor.
items.judgment: Pull from the older cursor and read the deleted flag and envelope.

items.criterion: A password change ends every other session.
items.judgment: Call a bearer endpoint with the other session's token after the change.

items.criterion: Another account's item reads as denied or not found.
items.judgment: Read the item with a second account's token.

items.criterion: A wrong secret and an unknown identifier are refused identically.
items.judgment: Compare the status and the body of both refusals.

items.criterion: Uploaded chunks exist in the bucket under vault/<file uuid>/<index>.
items.judgment: Check object existence for each chunk key after completion.

items.criterion: A lapsed account still downloads its existing file chunks.
items.judgment: Download chunk zero of each file item with the lapsed account's token.

items.criterion: The owner of a shared subscription reaches none of a member's items.
items.judgment: Read member item uuids with the owner's token and sync a write to one.

items.criterion: Unknown identifiers receive stable synthetic key parameters.
items.judgment: Request key parameters twice for one unknown identifier and once for another.

items.criterion: An unknown route answers 404 with the not-found page.
items.judgment: Request an unmatched address and read its status.
